name: Ordering app
summary: A made-up café's order-ahead app on a phone: the menu as drawn pictures with prices, two to a row, under chips for its sections; an item sheet with size, milk and extras and an Add button that says the price; a basket that rides above the tabs, with the collection time and one Pay button; and the order live, its line filling from received to being made to ready, with the number to show at the counter. From 768px the basket stays beside the menu, and the orders list beside the order. Onboarding, loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Welcome (drawing, one sentence, See the menu) → Menu: large title, where and how long, section chips that stay under the bar, items as pictures with name, line and price, a + on each, the basket bar low → Item sheet: its picture, size, milk, extras, how many, Add for £x → Basket: lines with − and +, when to collect, the sum, Pay £x low → Orders: the order on its way as the one card, earlier orders with Again → Order: ready time large, the steps filling live, the number for the counter, where → Account: grouped settings
type: humanist: warm, open letters that read well on a menu at 17px
motion: An app moves only to answer the person: a pushed screen slides in from the trailing edge, a tab cross-fades, the item sheet rises and drags down to close, and the order's line fills as it is made.
